end.summary:
Practised naming cube, cuboid, cylinder, cone and sphere in toys and objects.
Identified a candle and rocket-like object as cylinders and a cricket ball as a sphere.
Identified that a cylinder has two flat circular ends.
Mixed up cone naming when the cone was turned; this was not corrected by the last seen response.
Called a matchbox a cube without checking whether all faces are equal squares; this was not corrected by the last seen response.
end.parentNote: Asha practised identifying solid shapes using familiar toys and objects, and Aditya used the two circular ends to describe a cylinder. They also noticed that a matchbox has one shorter and one longer side, which is a useful observation. The mix-ups about a turned cone and whether every box is a cube were still present at the end. At home, ask Aditya to turn a cone and compare a cube with a cuboid by checking whether all faces are equal squares.
